title: Jönsson et al. (2006) PNAS & Smith et al. (2006) PNAS Up-the-Gradient Auxin-PIN1 Polarized Transport & Phyllotaxis Reference Dataset

primary_sources.citation: Jönsson H, Heisler MG, Shapiro BE, Meyerowitz EM, Mjolsness E (2006) An auxin-driven polarized transport model for phyllotaxis. PNAS 103(5):1633-1638
key_equations: da_i/dt = rho_0 - mu * a_i + T * sum_{j in N(i)} (P_ji * a_j - P_ij * a_i) + D * sum_{j in N(i)} (a_j - a_i)
P_ij = P_i * exp(c_1 * a_j) / sum_{k in N(i)} exp(c_1 * a_k)
Linear instability eigenvalue on 1D/2D cellular ring: sigma(k) = -mu + 2 * (T * P_0 * (c_1 * a_0 - 1) - D) * (1 - cos(k * l_0)) - kappa_4 * (1 - cos(k * l_0))^2

primary_sources.citation: Smith RS, Guyomarc'h S, Mandel T, Reinhardt D, Kuhlemeier C, Prusinkiewicz P (2006) A plausible model of phyllotaxis. PNAS 103(5):1301-1306
key_equations: PIN1_i->j = PIN1_i * b^(a_j) / sum_{k in N(i)} b^(a_k)   where c_1 = ln(b)
Primordium initiation threshold a_i >= a_thresh in peripheral zone (r in [R_CZ, R_PZ]), followed by radial tissue advection v_r(r) = gamma_adv * r and vascular sink depletion mu_prim * a_i

primary_sources.citation: Reinhardt D et al. (2003) Regulation of phyllotaxis by polar auxin transport. Nature 426:255-260
key_findings: NPA (1-N-naphthylphthalamic acid) or pin1-1 mutation blocks polar auxin transport (T -> 0), producing a bare pin-formed shoot apex with zero primordia
Localized microapplication of exogenous IAA (indole-3-acetic acid) lanolin paste onto an NPA-treated or pin1 apex induces a single lateral organ primordium at the site of application

phyllotactic_mode_regimes.label: Spiral Fibonacci (137.5°)
phyllotactic_mode_regimes.source: Smith et al. (2006) PNAS Fig. 3 & Jönsson et al. (2006) PNAS Fig. 4

phyllotactic_mode_regimes.label: Distichous Alternate (180.0°)
phyllotactic_mode_regimes.source: Smith et al. (2006) PNAS Fig. 4A (reduced central zone / smaller meristem ring)

phyllotactic_mode_regimes.label: Decussate Opposite Pairs (90.0°)
phyllotactic_mode_regimes.source: Smith et al. (2006) PNAS Fig. 4B & Jönsson et al. (2006) PNAS Fig. 3

phyllotactic_mode_regimes.label: Tricussate Whorled Triplets (60°/120°)
phyllotactic_mode_regimes.source: Smith et al. (2006) PNAS Fig. 4C (enlarged meristem ring / 3 simultaneous peaks)

wild_type_control.description: Intact up-the-gradient PIN1 polar transport (T = 1.20 h^-1, c_1 = 1.85)

npa_pin1_polar_transport_block.description: 10 uM NPA treatment or pin1-1 loss-of-function mutant (T = 0.0 h^-1, passive diffusion only)
npa_pin1_polar_transport_block.phenotype: Pin-formed bare inflorescence apex lacking lateral organ primordia (Reinhardt et al. 2003 Nature Fig. 1)

exogenous_iaa_microdroplet_rescue.description: NPA/pin1-1 apex + localized 1 mM IAA lanolin microdroplet at phi_paste = 60.0 deg on peripheral ring
exogenous_iaa_microdroplet_rescue.phenotype: Single localized radial organ primordium rescued at exact microapplication site (Reinhardt et al. 2003 Nature Fig. 2; Smith et al. 2006 Fig. 5)
